tweets.title: Nepal has lost the original documents of the 1816 Sugauli Treaty. Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal stated that the government cannot confirm if it possesses the original 1816 Sugauli Treaty. While secondary reference papers exist in the National Archives, extensive searches across state departments failed to locate the definitive, original signed document. The 1816 Sugauli Treaty, signed with British India after the Anglo-Nepal War, is the fundamental legal and historical basis for Nepal's modern territorial claims.
tweets.content:
